quantile_method: Arithmetic median; nearest-rank observed P95 for n>=20, P99 for n>=100. These are descriptive sample quantiles, not stable tail guarantees.

runs.timeout_scope: Whole benchmark process including fixture, warmup, timed samples and correctness validation; timeout is censored run evidence, not an operation latency.
runs.memory_scope: Top-level benchmark process, sampled every 100ms; includes fixture, warmup and oracle. Child CLI peaks require per-command metrics.
runs.memory_limitations: OS cumulative PeakWorkingSet64 is observed at startup, approximately every 100ms, and best-effort after exit. The last interval can be missed; no successful observations produce null, not zero. Descendant processes are excluded.
